_README: Copy this file, fill it in, delete the keys you do not need.
Every _comment key is ignored by the loader; the real keys are below them.
Validate for FREE first:  python -m cre.f1.sandbox_judge yourfile.json --dry-run
Then run for real (costs money):  ... yourfile.json
_comment_required: These four are required for EVERY taxonomy.
citing_sentence: The claim as the citing paper actually words it.

cited_claimed.title: Exact title of the paper being cited

cited_abstract: The cited paper's REAL abstract, verbatim from PubMed.
_comment_taxonomies: Which discriminators to run. Coverage/F6 always runs.
_comment_F5: F5 = was the cited work superseded by later evidence?

cited_sections.label: results
cited_sections.title: Primary outcome
cited_sections.text: A sentence copied VERBATIM from the cited paper. F5 and F7 check spans character-for-character against this text, so a paraphrase will fail.

_comment_F5_knobs: Cost/recall knobs. Defaults: cap 50, no budget, screen on.
_comment_F7: F7 = does the sentence name a DIFFERENT entity than the paper studied? Needs --authorities. cited_sections labels must be methods|results|table|figure.
_comment_F3: F3 = is the cited work the ORIGIN of the finding? Needs cited_pmcid, cited_is_review, the real reference list, and an abstracts map (pmid -> abstract) so candidates can be confirmed.

cited_reference_list.title: The primary paper the finding actually came from
